data.one_liner: Applies outer shadows, inner shadows, borders and gradients to Flutter controls and shapes.
data.what_it_does: Extends standard Flutter input borders and outlined borders with advanced styling parameters like inner/outer shadows, gradients, and custom border gradients. It allows wrapping standard shapes like RoundedRectangleBorder or OutlineInputBorder to decorate buttons, text fields, cards, and other controls consistently.
use_when: You need custom gradients, inner shadows, or outer shadows on buttons, text fields, or chips.
You want to animate button or input state changes involving shadows or gradient borders.
avoid_when: You only need standard Material Design 3 styling.
You are using controls that do not expose a shape field.
strengths: Applies uniform decorations across various Flutter controls and standard shapes.
Supports smooth interpolation and animation of custom shadows and border gradients.
weaknesses: Background gradients and inner shadows overlap the inner area of buttons due to Flutter limitations, requiring transparent colors.
